scripts.package:verify: sh -c 'if unzip -l clocktowerext.zip | rg -q "( dev/|/dev/| test_|/test_)"; then echo "ERROR: clocktowerext.zip contains dev/test files"; exit 1; else echo "OK: zip contains no dev/test files"; fi'
scripts.package:twitch: npm run build && rm -f clocktowerext.zip && (cd build && zip -r -q ../clocktowerext.zip . -x "dev/*" "*/dev/*" "test_*" "*/test_*") && npm run package:verify
